name: Yasashii Sekai no Manabikata
original_name: ヤサシイセカイの学び方
source:
It was winter, a year after I'd quit club.

"Have you heard? There's lesbians in the game club."
"That has to mean they're doing it."
"You think game club is a girls hookup spot now?"

I had to see if the gossip was true.
I chose one girl to see where things go...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130918.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那是我退部一年后的冬天。

“你听说了吗？游戏社里有女同性恋。”
“那肯定意味着她们正在做那种事。”
“你现在把游戏社当成女生联谊场所了吗？”

我必须确认传言是否属实。
我选中了一个女孩，想看看事情会如何发展……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130918.html]DLsite English[/url]]
